scope: Three entry applications, three position-holding policies and three exit policies per asset, jointly compared as 27 combinations per asset. Execution specialist audits three order-handling alternatives but maker fill performance is not inferred from daily bars.
selection: Freeze all inputs before PnL; select combination per asset on development only by maximum worst-scenario(net - 0.5 * close drawdown), lexical ties. Cash included as zero-utility alternative. Lock before later evaluation; no later reselection. Separately report development-only single-stage choices against baseline and selected-combination component removals.
chronology: At UTC open d execute previously scheduled orders. At open d+60 seconds finalize bar d-1 and make decisions using only finalized bars and already observed fills. New requests execute no earlier than open d+lag-1, where lag is 2 or 3. Entry size and entry ATR use latest finalized bar d-2 at execution open d. No high/low touch fills or retrospective fills.
pendingOrders: One pending intent. The entry gate fires once; it need not repeat while pending. Cancel entry if its underlying baseline thesis becomes cash at an intervening decision before its due open. Each intent has only its fixed due-open fill attempt, with no backfilling. Committed exit intent is not canceled. No new entry on the calendar day of a sale. These are historical research intents, not claims of venue order submission/acceptance.
holding: Age and thesis-break confirmations count newly finalized bars that opened at or after the actual entry fill. Risk and maximum-age exits override minimum holding. Confirmation counts repeated daily observations, not independent weekly BTC information.
exits: Only finalized closes trigger protective, trailing or profit exits. ATR is fixed at entry using finalized true ranges; trailing peaks use post-entry finalized closes. Exit order fills at a future costed open. Stops do not guarantee a maximum loss; gaps and delays can overrun thresholds.
controls: Baseline combination preserves existing BTC native-week or ETH40 daily eligibility and first post-entry finalized-bar thesis exit, normalized into this new daily event lifecycle and account sizing. Pre-entry bars do not count toward holding or exit decisions, which can delay exits versus earlier target-array replays. Every window resets to cash and first decides from the first in-window bar after it finalizes; pre-window entry signals are ignored. Passive asset has the same first-entry delay and gets only one entry per window; cash earns zero. Baseline is not exact running-service execution parity.
limitations: Known reused history and 54 combinations prevent untouched holdout or universal best-system claims.
Costed OHLC opens assume full liquidity. Maker queues, partial venue fills, stale live quotes and cancel races cannot be ranked from this data.

Full exit liquidity and current instrument rules are historical screening assumptions. Exit minimum violations are counted but not rejected or partially filled; any violation disqualifies the screen. A missing or zero entry ATR disables price barriers and is counted; such entries disqualify risk-policy screening.
Separate periods reset cash; terminal liquidation pays fees and is excluded from natural episodes.
Daily-low drawdown measures prior observed close peak to daily low, not intraday pathwise maximum.
The existing current-signal hysteresis state is entry eligibility; re-entry while long eligibility remains can occur after an independent exit. Churn must be measured, not hidden.
No live trading, frozen-service changes, additional server ports, or automatic activation.
